scope: Three independently verified Minecraft JVMs, real native FE capabilities, real MySQL, trusted console fixtures

measurement.clock: One Python observer's monotonic clock; event intervals bound observation times
measurement.sql: Read-only SELECTs through the existing isolated development root observer; no SQL mutations
measurement.conservation: Accepted FE = extracted FE + channel pool + SQL-owned remaining. SQL/local/WAL copies are not added together.
measurement.dedup: After actual extraction and SQL consumption, compare exact transfer IDs/amounts/states/remaining and pool rows across at least one configured idle-poll interval
measurement.fairness: Every registered receiving endpoint must receive positive FE; equal shares are not required. Raw global SQL last_grant values are retained.
measurement.counters: Raw cumulative baselines and deltas include ambient fixtures. Earlier quota_exhausted errors and deadlock retries remain in the baseline; aggregate errors do not identify error codes.
measurement.wal: The live runtime persists through its actual world journal; this script observes capabilities and SQL, and does not independently parse WAL bytes or measure fsync.
measurement.revision: Checkout HEAD is recorded; loaded JVM code revision is supplied by the operator and is not independently proven by this harness
